warnings.headline: Ice, yellow level, Parts of Finnmark
warnings.description: From Saturday evening until late  Sunday morning there is risk of glaze ice due to mild temperatures and rain.
warnings.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Wet ice on the road: Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Consider using ice spikes or studded shoes: Be aware that the ice can be difficult to see. Follow the updates: Stay updated on weather warnings. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/traf
